content.statement: The current returns_policy_v2 explicitly sets a 30-day full-refund window for standard items, so the claimed current 30-day window is supported.
content.plan: Parsed policy_docs for the current standard-item return window, compared it with the stale base_retrieval v1 and base_judge_reference_days values, checked the 10-day-old standard order against both windows, and computed the numeric delta; raw event-count RR was not computable because no events_treat/events_ctrl/tot_treat/tot_ctrl fields exist.

evidence.note: No raw event counts are present, so the RR endpoint is not applicable; the direct policy numeric comparison supports the 30-day current window.
